fields.value: Privacy Policy

fields.label: Small heading above
fields.value: Privacy Policy

fields.label: Main heading
fields.value: How we look after your information.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: This policy explains what personal information Lava Street Dental collects, why we collect it, how we keep it safe, and how you can see or correct it.

fields.label: Fine print
fields.value: Last updated: November 2026

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Who we are

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Lava Street Dental is a dental practice at {{addressLine}}, Australia, opening in December 2026. In this policy, “we”, “us” and “our” mean Lava Street Dental.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: As a health service provider, we must follow the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth), including the Australian Privacy Principles, and the Health Records Act 2001 (Vic), including the Health Privacy Principles. These laws apply to us whatever our size.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Privacy contact

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Email:

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Phone:

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Post: Privacy Officer, Lava Street Dental, {{addressLine}}

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What we collect

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Before we open. When you join our waitlist we collect your first and last name, email address, mobile number if you choose to give it, and your agreement to be contacted. When you use our contact form we also collect your message. Please do not include health information in website forms; we will talk to you about anything clinical directly.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Once we open. To provide dental care we collect:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: contact details, date of birth and an emergency contact

fields.label: List item
fields.value: health information, such as your medical and dental history, medications, allergies, clinical notes, X-rays, scans, photographs and treatment plans

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Medicare, Department of Veterans’ Affairs and private health fund details, and Child Dental Benefits Schedule eligibility

fields.label: List item
fields.value: billing and payment information

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: You can make a general enquiry without giving your name. We cannot provide treatment anonymously, because we need to keep accurate clinical records.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: How we collect it

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Usually directly from you: through our website forms, in person, by phone or by email. Sometimes we receive information from other people, such as a referring dentist or doctor, a specialist, a parent or guardian, your health fund, Medicare or the Department of Veterans’ Affairs. We only do this with your consent or where the law allows it.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: When you visit our website, our hosting provider automatically records basic technical information, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested. See Cookies and analytics below.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why we use it

fields.label: List item
fields.value: to keep you updated about our opening if you have joined the waitlist

fields.label: List item
fields.value: to reply to your enquiries

fields.label: List item
fields.value: to assess, diagnose and treat you, and to keep accurate clinical records

fields.label: List item
fields.value: to send appointment reminders and recall notices

fields.label: List item
fields.value: to process payments and claims with Medicare, the Department of Veterans’ Affairs and health funds

fields.label: List item
fields.value: to run the practice, including quality, safety and staff training

fields.label: List item
fields.value: to meet our legal and professional obligations

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We only use your information for another purpose if you agree, or if it is a related purpose you would reasonably expect, or if the law requires or allows it.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Who we share it with

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We only share what is needed, with:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: specialists, doctors and other health practitioners involved in your care, including when we refer you

fields.label: List item
fields.value: dental laboratories that make crowns, bridges, dentures and appliances for you

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Medicare, the Department of Veterans’ Affairs and your health fund, to process claims

fields.label: List item
fields.value: payment providers you choose to use, such as our card terminal provider (Tyro), Afterpay and humm

fields.label: List item
fields.value: service providers who help us run the practice, such as our practice management software provider, IT support, our website host (Vercel) and our email delivery service for website forms (SMTP2GO)

fields.label: List item
fields.value: anyone we are required or authorised by law to tell, for example under a court order, to a regulator, or to lessen a serious threat to someone’s life, health or safety

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We do not sell or rent your personal information.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Information stored outside Australia

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Some of our service providers store or process information outside Australia:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: our website is hosted by Vercel, which uses servers in the United States and other countries

fields.label: List item
fields.value: waitlist and contact form submissions are sent by email through our email delivery service, SMTP2GO, which may store or process data outside Australia

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Google provides the fonts and maps on our website, from servers in the United States and elsewhere

fields.label: List item
fields.value: patient records are managed by our practice at {{addressLine}}, using practice management software; ask our privacy contact if you would like to know where that software stores data

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We take reasonable steps to make sure these providers protect your information in line with Australian privacy law.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Marketing and how to unsubscribe

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We only send waitlist updates and practice news if you have agreed to receive them. Every email tells you how to stop them: reply with “remove”, or contact us using the details above. Appointment reminders and messages about your treatment are not marketing, and continue while you are a patient.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Cookies and analytics

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our website does not set its own cookies and does not use analytics or advertising tracking. A few third-party services are involved:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: our fonts load from Google Fonts, so Google receives your IP address; Google Fonts does not set cookies

fields.label: List item
fields.value: the maps on our contact and location pages are embedded from Google Maps, and Google may set cookies when a map loads

fields.label: List item
fields.value: our website host keeps short-term server logs (IP address, browser and pages visited) for security and to keep the site running

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If we add analytics in the future, we will update this policy first.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Keeping it safe, and how long we keep it

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We store information in secure systems with access limited to staff who need it, protected by passwords and other safeguards. Our team is bound by confidentiality. Paper records, if any, are kept secured. When information is no longer needed, we destroy it securely or de-identify it.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We keep health records for as long as Victorian law requires: at least seven years after your last visit or, if you were under 18 at your last visit, at least until you turn 25. We keep waitlist details until we have contacted you about opening, or until you ask us to remove them.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Seeing and correcting your information

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: You can ask to see the information we hold about you, or ask us to correct it, by contacting our privacy contact. We will respond within 30 days. There is no fee to make a request. We may charge a reasonable fee for providing copies of records, as the law allows, and we will tell you the cost first. In limited circumstances the law allows us to refuse access; if so, we will explain why in writing.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Data breaches

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If a data breach involving your information is likely to cause you serious harm, we will notify you and the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner, as required by the Notifiable Data Breaches scheme.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Questions and complaints

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If you have a question or a concern about how we have handled your information, please contact our privacy contact first. We will acknowledge your complaint promptly and aim to resolve it within 30 days.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If you are not satisfied with our response, you can contact:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC): www.oaic.gov.au, 1300 363 992

fields.label: List item
fields.value: the Victorian Health Complaints Commissioner: hcc.vic.gov.au, 1300 582 113

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Changes to this policy

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version is always on this page.

fields.label: Fine print
fields.value: Last updated: November 2026
